name: Tiergarten Schönbrunn
notes: Site only publishes a handful of ticketed/bookable 'Termine' (Safari Dinner, Polarnacht, workshops, kids advent tours, Artenschutztage); daily animal feedings and the year-round zoo itself are not modelled as occurrences. Site publishes concrete future dates only a few months out per event (site's own 'Nächste Termine' lists), so record count is small and genuinely thin, not a scraper bug.
